thread:
emma: Heads-up — Customer acct 98765 (org: NebulaApps) hit a payment flow blocker when trying to redeem the free trial promo. UI shows 'Add card to continue' and the card add fails on the SCA step. PaymentIntent: pi_3KXyzExample

cj: Can you paste the exact error from the payment provider? Any browser console/network trace or Stripe webhook payload would help.

emma: Webhook shows auth_required -> last_payment_error: {"type":"issuers_failure","message":"authentication challenge cancelled by user","code":"authentication_required"}
I also have a screenshot from the customer where the 3-D Secure modal flashes then closes immediately.

billing-bot: automated note: this account has 0 usage and pending promo: FREE30. Promo requires card-on-file per TOS. Attempts: 3 in last 24h.

sophie: Common culprit: our client-side SCA modal being blocked by browser extensions or cross-origin iframe issues. Which webview/browser did the user use?

emma: Customer on mobile Safari (iOS 16). They say the modal shows 'Unable to complete authentication' then goes back to app. No extension there.

sam: Repro steps request:
1) On staging, open /billing/subscribe
2) Select "Start free trial"
3) Enter test card that triggers SCA (e.g., 4000 0025 0000 3155 for Stripe)
4) Complete challenge -> observe
I tried on Chrome desktop and the modal works. On iOS Safari it fails for me too (challenge closes immediately).

emma: Adding raw webhook from the failed event:
```
{ "id": "evt_1JxExample", "type": "payment_intent.payment_failed", "data": { "object": { "id": "pi_3KXyzExample", "last_payment_error": { "message": "3DS authentication canceled by user", "code": "authentication_required" } } } }
```

mike-support: Customer asking for trial credits now — they're blocked from onboarding. Is there a safe manual workaround to grant the trial without charging a card?

sophie: Policy: free-trial promo requires a verified card on file to prevent abuse. We can temporarily issue credits manually but need a billing approval & audit trail. For this one we can consider manual grant up to $50. Above that needs finance sign-off.

cj: Short-term technical mitigations:
- Try a fallback payment flow: client creates ephemeral token + server attaches card directly via PaymentMethod attach flow (bypass our custom iframe). If card still triggers SCA, will need successful challenge.
- If SCA consistently fails on iOS Safari, ask customer to try Chrome on Android or desktop. Not ideal but useful for troubleshooting.

emma: I've asked the customer for a short screen recording. Also asked them to try adding the card via desktop and to confirm the exact time of the failure so we can correlate webhooks.

billing-bot: ticket created: BILL-4321 — requester: NebulaApps / acct 98765 — issue: SCA challenge failing, blocking FREE30 promo. Priority: P2.

mike-support: Finance: can you approve a one-off $30 credit until we confirm root cause? I'll add the audit note and require customer acknowledgement.

sophie: Approving provisional credit is fine for up to $30. Add note: "manual grant due to SCA failure; require follow-up within 7 days or revoke." Please cc @finance.

cj: Action items for eng/payments:
- Investigate client-side iframe handshake on iOS Safari for our hosted widget.
- Check if SameSite/crossorigin headers or CSP are interfering with the challenge popup.
- Add enhanced logging around PaymentIntent events and client session id to correlate failures.

emma: I'll push the screenshot and the customer's user-agent string to BILL-4321 and post the screen recording when they send it. For now, doing the manual $30 grant.

mike-support: Done — manual credit of $30 applied to acct 98765. Noted billing ticket and audit entry. Customer notified: "We've applied a one-time $30 onboarding credit while we investigate — please try onboarding again or share the recording."

sophie: Thank you. Follow-up: once we have repro, we should add a short KB article (internal + public) about SCA failures on iOS webviews and recommended customer steps.

emma: Copy. I'll keep this thread updated as we get the recording and webhook timestamps.

sam: If anyone else sees the same pattern, please drop notes in BILL-4321 so we can detect a trend before rolling a mitigation. :eyes:
